cluster_reuse_safety_2026_07_30.question: Is it SAFE to publish one QC-approved image to every product row sharing a craft option? The entire budget model (1979 rows -> 1140 images, ~735 credits saved) depends on yes.
cluster_reuse_safety_2026_07_30.method: For each candidate clustering key, grouped all 1979 in-scope rows and checked whether every multi-row group agrees on a single techpackIllustration. A group whose rows point at DIFFERENT drawings cannot be served by one photo.

result_key_field_option.verdict: UNSAFE AS-IS — 4 identities diverge, all coin-pocket (coin-none/left/right/both), 24 rows affected.
result_key_field_option.why: A coin pocket on TROUSERS is not the same photograph as a coin pocket on a JACKET. Jacket rows point at /images/jacket/coin-pocket/*.jpg; trouser rows point at localized remote drawings. Keying on field+option alone would wire a trouser photo onto a jacket.

result_key_part_field_option_label.verdict: SAFE — zero divergence across the entire in-scope catalog.
result_key_part_field_option_label.why: The part field separates them: jacket-pocket / jacket-detail / trouser-small-pocket.

cluster_reuse_safety_2026_07_30.decision: Cluster on part|field|option|label, NOT field|option. This is also the key the 1140-image budget was computed from, so the budget and the safety proof agree.
